verdict.rationale: Parahelp is a SaaS customer-support agent platform, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes self-hosted or on-prem deployment. API access, custom internal endpoints, and admin controls over data retention are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
